name: What is the difference between baseboard and crown molding for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between baseboard and crown molding for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboard and crown molding are both types of trim, but they serve different purposes and are installed in different locations. Baseboards are installed at the bottom of the walls, where they meet the floor. Their primary function is to cover the gap between the wall and flooring, protecting the wall from scuffs and impacts. Crown molding, on the other hand, is installed at the top of the walls, where they meet the ceiling, adding an elegant decorative transition. Both can enhance a bathroom's finished look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboards cover the gap between walls and the floor, protecting walls. Crown molding is installed where walls meet the ceiling, adding a decorative transition.
